description:
List the event lists (nationwide / each region / each kind) and the
new-arrivals list that a user can follow. Following a list delivers
notifications of new events in it. Pass an entry's `type` and `slug`
to toggle_favorite (target_type = type, token = slug) to follow or
unfollow it.

Coverage: a wider list includes narrower ones. Following nationwide
(`all/all`) already covers every region and kind, so do not also
follow a region on top of it. `all/<area>` covers every kind in that
region, `<kind>/all` covers that kind in every region.

By default only single-axis lists are returned. Pass `kind` and/or
`area` to also get the combinations for them (e.g. kind=book_club
returns book clubs nationwide and in each region, plus the wider lists
that cover them), or `combinations: true` for every combination.

Filtering by kind or area leaves out the new-arrivals (creation_zone)
entry.

With a Bearer token that has favorites:read, each entry also carries
`following` (true/false) and `covered_by` (the slug of a wider list the
user already follows that includes it, or null). `covered_by` is set
even when `following` is true, which means the follow is redundant.

area.description: Return the lists for this region of Japan (lowercase slug, e.g. "kanto", "kansai"): every kind in that region plus the wider lists covering it. Combine with `kind` to narrow further. Omit for every region.

combinations.description: true = also return every kind x region combination (about a hundred entries); false (default) = only the single-axis lists: nationwide, each region, each kind. Prefer `kind` / `area` to get just the combinations you need.

kind.description: Return the lists for this event kind: that kind nationwide and in each region, plus the wider lists covering them (non_genre = general ZINE event, zine_making = ZINE-making workshop, author = author event (talk, signing), festival_style = fair / market with many booths, zine_cafe = ZINE cafe, book_club = book club, utakai = tanka poetry gathering, period_event = multi-day exhibitions / fairs). Omit for every kind. An unknown value returns an error result with `error: "invalid_argument"`.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

name: list_followable_zones
